2. It may alſoalso teach us that Miniſtersministers ought not to make a Bargainbargain with the Peoplepeople, or deſiredesire to know what they ſhallshall have before they enter on their Workwork; for he who would approve himſelfhimself a true Miniſterminister of JeſusJesus

This may teach us two things. div.p: THEThe Naturenature and Weightineſsweightiness of the Workwork of the Faithfulfaithful Servantservant of ChriſtChrist, together with the neceſſitynecessity and difficulty of it, we ſhallshall conſiderconsider in its parts in a brief and compendious manner.
